execution_amendment.authorization: User approved real input capture and one bounded diagnostic after these amendments are committed
execution_amendment.no_intervention_identity: For every one of the 24 captured documents, reconstruct the full 64-expert MoE output with original BF16 weights, captured inputs/indices/gates and the original expert iteration/linear/activation/gate/index_add order. Require shape, dtype and all element bits equal to the original captured MoE block output. No tolerance relaxation after quantization results.
execution_amendment.memory_isolation: Every timed B or C run uses a fresh subprocess. Record process lifetime maximum RSS, baseline RSS, model/output-cache residency stages and GPU allocated/reserved peaks. Never reuse a previous run's cumulative RSS high-water mark.
execution_amendment.selection_scope: The four experts are deliberately selected to favor observed calibration co-routing. Report per-expert activation, all six pair co-routing counts, and number of held-out tokens selecting at least two of the four. Do not describe them as a representative random expert sample.
execution_amendment.runtime_details_before_measurement: Native eager expert execution; SDPA in the unmodified prefix; BF16 weights, deterministic algorithms, TF32 and BF16 reduced-precision reduction disabled; four CPU/BLAS threads. Preserve each expert's whole-document dispatch GEMM batch for BF16 agreement; stream objective evaluation in 64-token tiles with at most one document error bank resident for either method. Prefix capture stops after the target block; no downstream model quality evaluation.
execution_amendment.complete_cost_accounting: Use model download duration plus complete preparation subprocess wall time as the common one-shot cost, including identity/packing verification and input persistence. Add each independent worker's complete subprocess wall time. Report these common audit costs and worker load/collection/selection/hash components separately. Peak memory is max(common preparation peak, independent worker peak).

decision: Perform one bounded local allocation diagnostic next; no research-method adoption or whole-model experiment yet

model.routing: Capture actual reference expert indices and applied gate values; freeze them for A/B/C; never renormalize top-8 weights
model.reference_inputs: Inputs to the selected MoE block from the unmodified BF16 model; eval mode; batch size 1; use_cache false

data.sampling: Parse articles using top-level WikiText headings; retain articles >=512 tokenizer tokens; seeded article permutation and one seeded 512-token contiguous window per article. No document reuse, exclude cross-split exact document-hash duplicates.
data.before_scores: Freeze document IDs, text and token hashes and window offsets before quantized error collection; never tune using held-out scores
data.current_status: Revision pinned; text/token selection not executed

expert_selection.available_information: Calibration routing only; no quantization errors or held-out routing
expert_selection.rule: Compute W[e,f]=sum_t g[t,e]*g[t,f] for co-routed experts. Choose the largest-weight pair, then greedily add the expert with largest summed W to the selected set until four. Ties: lowest sorted expert IDs. Sort selected IDs for candidate slots.
expert_selection.zero_coactivation: If all pair weights are zero, record absence of cross-term opportunity and end this layer's diagnostic; do not search other layers
expert_selection.remaining_experts: BF16; fixed residual offset r0=0 in this first diagnostic. This is a restricted four-expert subproblem, not compression of all 64 experts.

quantization.method: Independent reference implementation of grouped affine RTN matching the inspected formulation; no new quantizer
quantization.arithmetic: Freeze BF16 operator order and nearest-even rounding before data collection; preserve stored BF16 scale/zero values
quantization.packed_layout: 32-bit words with floor(32/b) codes per word, column packing, zero tail padding, transpose; BF16 scale and zero per group
quantization.round_trip_gate: All codes, metadata and dequantized tensors must match the un-packed RTN reference across all 4 experts and 3 precisions. Reject before collecting allocation errors if not.
quantization.inference_scope: Dequantize the reference packed weights for BF16 expert evaluation. Not GEMQ Triton inference or a compressed-serving throughput measurement.
quantization.full_gemq_execution: Deferred; existing environment does not satisfy its requirements. No need to install its whole stack for this objective diagnostic.

allocation.candidates: All 12 unique permutations, sorted lexicographically; same first candidate and traversal for A/B/C
allocation.accounting: Reference code+scale+zero payload only. Count all additional tensor/selection metadata, padding, and common BF16 weights separately before calling deployed candidates equal-byte. File container size is not payload size.
allocation.prohibited_equal_budget_comparison: All-3-bit candidate has 327680 more reference payload bytes; do not silently compare it as equal-budget
allocation.optimum_scope: Exhaustive minimum only over these 12 calibration candidates and the specified objective

objectives.weighted_error: u[t,e,b]=float64(g[t,e])*(float64(E_quant[t,e,b])-float64(E_BF16[t,e])); expert outputs/gates are captured from the same fixed routing
objectives.B: mean_t ||sum_e u[t,e,b_e]||^2, cached residual and squared-norm updates on union of changed experts' affected token rows
objectives.C: Same as B using precomputed usable expert/precision inner products on co-active tokens
objectives.fixed_offset: If a later design quantizes other experts, include r0 in B and its linear cross terms in C; this extension is not today's experiment
objectives.implementation_precision: FP64 CPU reductions; exact formula for cached outputs, not bit-exact native BF16 MoE accumulation

tie_rule.action: Lexicographically smallest candidate within atol+rtol*abs(best) of minimum; tied changes are not evidence of improved allocation

objectives.validity: Audit all 12 B/C scores against independent direct sums; same selected allocation required. Negative scores outside tolerance, mismatches or tie inconsistency invalidate the numerical comparison, not the research hypothesis.

held_out.selection: Choose A and B allocations on calibration only; C must select B's allocation
held_out.primary: Paired per-document mean squared output norm on held-out fixed inputs/routing, using the same FP64 weighted-error definition
held_out.gain: 1-sum_document L_B/sum_document L_A; if denominator is zero, no improvement opportunity
held_out.uncertainty: 10000 paired document bootstrap resamples, seed 20261031, percentile 95% interval; tokens are not independent resampling units
held_out.native_guard: Also evaluate native BF16 block outputs for the two selected allocations at fixed routing. Require pooled native error L_A-L_B > 1e-10 + 1e-9*max(abs(L_A),abs(L_B)); a reversal or numerical tie ends the quality direction. No new 5% native threshold is imposed.
held_out.proceed_quality: At least 5% held-out FP64 objective reduction and bootstrap lower bound above 0, plus a native BF16 block error reduction beyond the predeclared numerical tie band. This is an exploratory resource-allocation threshold, not a perceptual or whole-model quality guarantee.
held_out.failure_scope: If choices are tied/same or the threshold is not met, end cross-term quality development for this diagnostic; no alternative layer/bitset added to rescue the result

per_method_costs: Reference and quantized expert output collection
B residual/cache preparation or C Gram construction
All 12 candidate evaluations and tie handling
cost.fairness: Same expert-output bank, candidate order and evaluation count. Permit both methods to stream 64-token tiles. Never charge B with rerunning all experts per candidate or retaining a whole-dataset bank unnecessarily.
cost.measurement: Warm up once per method, then three independent paired complete runs in orders B-C, C-B, B-C. Verify actual replayed weighted error data agree. Report one-shot total including common setup and the selection-phase subtotal; no speed claim from lookup time alone.
cost.memory: Fresh independent process per timed B/C run; report lifetime peak RSS, stage baseline RSS and GPU allocated/reserved peaks separately. Record model/output-cache residency; common preparation peak is combined with worker peak by maximum, not sum. Actual use and caps remain distinct.
cost.proceed_cost: Same scores/choice, plus >=10% median one-shot wall-time reduction with positive gains in all 3 pairs, or >=20% peak process-RSS reduction with <=5% time penalty and no higher GPU peak. Otherwise do not develop a speed method on this candidate set.
cost.current_cpu_test: Correctness only; its small run time is not a cost comparison

future_execution_caps.clock: From first model/data preparation action, including download, warmup, validation and retries; no automatic extension
future_execution_caps.on_cap: Stop and report completed/invalid/incomplete counts; resource failure is not evidence of no quality gain

next_action: Implement the local model/input capture and packed RTN round-trip preflight under these fixed baselines. Only after it passes may the bounded real-model diagnostic begin.
